mechanism: User-proposed Log-Scaled LeRoPE with SSMax retained; w(p)=p*log(p+1), zero-based global per-token p.
statement: First-token angle is zero. Arbitrary learned rotations preserve norm. Rotary scores depend on w(t)-w(s); the two unit gaps between positions 0,1 and 1,2 are provably unequal in warped coordinates.
assumptions: Arbitrary finite real angles, frequencies and vectors; the same fixed learned frequencies are used for query/key rotations during cached decoding. Norm preservation does not require a linear position map. Positive base and finite real log-scales retain the inherited frequency positivity.
nonvacuity: Four rotary bands/eight channels, arbitrary nonzero-capable vectors and log-scales, distinct positions 3 and 8, positive base 1/10000. The unequal-gap theorem uses explicit positions 0,1,2.
inherited: PeriBounds residual RMS <= 1+sqrt(2L); NormalizedScores SSMax score <= log(N)*abs(g)*d with eps,d>0 and N>=1; ScalableSoftmax conditional margin bound unchanged. Their existing records and assumptions remain applicable.
limitations: Ordinary relative-token-distance invariance is not claimed. Unequal warped gaps are a coordinate counterexample, not a claim that all vector scores differ. No full-network derivative, convergence, grokking, extrapolation or floating-point theorem. The exponential learned-frequency range remains unbounded. Singleton and causal/cache correctness are additionally checked numerically.
implementation_bridge: Manual equation review plus independent position/equation, finite-difference, cache and native-vs-captured optimizer tests; no formal PyTorch translation.
